name: TUR Stake spot-priced power and unaccrued referral power
summary: The TUR Stake contract converts staked TUR into mining power from the spot reserves of the TUR/NOBEL and NOBEL/USDT PancakeSwap pairs, and credits 20% and 5% of that power to the staker's first two referrers by raising their power without adjusting their rewardDebt, so each referrer can immediately claim the new power times the whole accumulated reward per share. The attacker borrowed 1.9M USDT, bought NOBEL and TUR to inflate both spot prices, staked 840,992 TUR from an account bound under its own referrer accounts, and had those referrers claim, draining the contract's entire 18.8M TUR reward balance before selling it back to USDT.

loss.notes: The Stake contract's TUR balance fell from 18797013.727945965666304686 at block 88871541 to 1 wei at 88871542. Of that, 589140.185415031974863037 TUR went as the 3% claim fee to the project fund wallet 0xb3026bdc58c591c1137a1fec9506915e39789923 (logs 20, 24) and is excluded, and the attacker's own 840992.452555100162463228 TUR staked in (log 23) is netted out, leaving 18207873.542530933691441648 TUR taken by the referrer accounts (logs 21 and 25 in, forwarded to the attacker at 22 and 26). The attacker's selling moved the TUR price, so the value is the realised gain: the EOA received 2033398.302560718774502099 USDT from the NOBEL/USDT pair (log 71) against the 1900000 USDT it put in (log 5) and repaid (75), a gain of 133398.302560718774502099 USDT, forwarded with 92.09 USDT of its own balance as 133490.392419136677677840 USDT to 0xef670d9c2e24d1788f39ad35c70f4cc51b4e5898 (log 77). USDT is valued at par; 76303.19 USDT of NOBEL transfer tax paid to 0x972bfaae4093baf00bd5b4db2e11d143adc16f97 during the sale is not counted.

ageReset.description: The project deployer's top-level creation installed the non-upgradeable Stake runtime; the constructor fixed both pair addresses used for pricing, and the runtime hash was unchanged through the exploit.

sources.note: Identity: Stake 0x03d8096377ea7683d840e395d72439f7b6415abe (Etherscan V2 getsourcecode chainid 56: ContractName Stake, Proxy 0) has no code at block 71014792 and 6168 bytes with keccak 0xc5cb81fb64694e1ec7becad47adf35b0112eca801e7e3d674b8723f4b8c5d276 at 71014793 and 88871541; receipt of 0x39497ced... (tx index 155) has contractAddress 0x03d80963... and sender 0x18cd0ba15c362894ef39f50d1cb35b61d7a9759e, which also created the TUR token 0xe83ee4a30e97887e6b9745be40e5f5aa88888888. The contract has no owner-settable pricing or reward parameters (turNobelPair, nobelUPair, rewardPerSecond set in the constructor), so no configuration change can reset the age. Code age = 1774541036 - 1765262804 = 9278232 s (107.4 days).

Anchor: debug_traceTransaction(callTracer) of 0x96c9ce3c... (block 88871542, tx index 0, status 1), sent by 0xc93a5ab3737081f00788b61da42281955d3df692 to itself (EIP-7702-delegated EOA, so stake()'s msg.sender == tx.origin check passes): 1900000 USDT from 0x8f73b65b4caaf64fba2af91cc5d4a2a1318e5d8c (log 1), swap into NOBEL on pair 0x5743b2bc41c844c99de3a7f0e5da046224f6786e and into TUR on pair 0xdb051a2a2a936b83c942aa40e74ff273b0f8c2e2, then Stake.stake (0xa694fc3a) reading getReserves of both pairs, then claim() (0x4e71d92d) from referrer accounts 0xfd11c78a2ffc9102080f1accfb2c9cd2ce2aceab and 0x9007983c0b1db337e3c0ff29771027b8e2be550b (TUR out at logs 21 and 25); the third referrer 0xef79bbd4efac4be248af6525971002f80eb251e0's claim reverts for insufficient balance; the TUR is sold back through both pairs. Root cause (verified source): getPowerAmount = getTURPrice() * amount * getNobelPrice() with both prices reserve ratios from pair.getReserves(); _distributeRefPower adds power*20/100 and power*5/100 to users[ref].power and powerTotal without touching rewardDebt, and earned() = power*accRewardPerShare/1e12 - rewardDebt. Earliest exercise: Etherscan tokentx of TUR for the Stake from block 0 to 88871542 (84317 transfers, 84310 outflows, first at block 71914968) shows the largest earlier outflow is 50261.37 TUR (0x3245edeb..., block 83873820), against 15238941.52 and 3809924.47 TUR here, so no earlier drain. Loss is computed in the loss notes from the anchor receipt; the Stake balance is from balanceOf at blocks 88871541 and 88871542.
